name: playwright-ui-testing
description: Visual regression and interaction audit framework for ksolves.com

scripts.visual: rm -rf test-results playwright-report && npx playwright test tests/visual/
scripts.baseline: rm -rf test-results playwright-report && npx playwright test tests/visual/ --update-snapshots=all
scripts.interaction: rm -rf interaction-results interaction-report storage && npx playwright test tests/interaction/ --config playwright.interaction.config.js
scripts.interaction:endpoints: rm -rf interaction-results interaction-report storage && CRAWL_ENDPOINTS=true npx playwright test tests/interaction/ --config playwright.interaction.config.js
